view-01.png.evidence: Aircraft on the outside of the swarm remain distinguishable.
view-01.png.regressions: Soft circular particles hide deck features and objectives intersect the scene.

view-02.png.evidence: Tight tree contacts distinguish small crowns from the longer hangar shadows. Brackets frame dark wings over the hangar while leaving the runway and wing paint visible.
view-02.png.regressions: Broad grass remains even and the player still crosses the roof line.

view-03.png.evidence: Crisp aircraft and hot sparks lift from a finely broken dark sea. Side brackets remain visible amid cream wings, with one gold direction cue.
view-03.png.regressions: The broad opaque mission card masks aircraft at the upper edge; a nearby wing and spark overlap the pilot.

view-04.png.evidence: Sharp runway and neat building silhouettes with useful raised geometry.
view-04.png.regressions: The player merges with a blue roof; broad flat greens and a straight shore lack transition detail.

view-05.png.evidence: Thin silhouettes and deck details survive crowded action; several plane shadows separate height.
view-05.png.regressions: Sea flecks and combat flecks have similar scale, with aircraft partly behind HUD.

view-06.png.evidence: Brackets are still readable amid softened aircraft, and the finer sea surface gives contrast to the pale silhouettes and smoke.
view-06.png.regressions: The left cue abuts a cream wing and the right cue sits close to another plane, so identification still takes a beat.

view-07.png.evidence: Single light carrier remains easy to locate.
view-07.png.regressions: Blurred bow aircraft merges into the deck; the slab-like wake and center labels flatten the image.

view-08.png.evidence: Dark aircraft bracketed at the bow while pale aircraft stand apart over the water. Wake is broader than the fine wave pattern.
view-08.png.regressions: Soft deck lines and the cream bow aircraft compete with the pilot.

view-09.png.evidence: Isolated carrier silhouette and bright deck stripes are distinct.
view-09.png.regressions: Bow aircraft is nearly part of the deck and the rigid rectangular wake flattens the scene.

view-10.png.evidence: Market stalls, detailed paving and long shadows create consistent visual space; route marks remain identifiable.
view-10.png.regressions: Similar dark human silhouettes are easy to lose beside stalls.

view-11.png.evidence: Runway is apparent even with soft output.
view-11.png.regressions: The plane and the objective collide; simplified roofs and mottled ground have little relief.

view-12.png.evidence: Runway orientation and blocks of farmland are quick to recognize.
view-12.png.regressions: Objective overlays the plane; spotted ground, polygonal trees and straight white shore compete.

view-13.png.evidence: Wet surface highlights, reflected light, smoke and wreckage reinforce a layered weather scene.
view-13.png.regressions: Small troops and the tank merge with dark ground in parts of the frame.

view-14.png.evidence: White wings remain recognizable even at high density.
view-14.png.regressions: Large translucent circles hide the deck and indicators; wake is a rectangular slab.

view-15.png.evidence: Compact tree contacts and the cyan shallow-water band give the coast depth. High-contrast square corners identify the aircraft against bright grass.
view-15.png.regressions: The angular shoreline and repeating crowns remain visible.

view-16.png.evidence: Illuminated wall rims and cool room shadows organize a detailed floor plan; colored marks distinguish routes.
view-16.png.regressions: Small markings and dense furniture require a closer look.

view-17.png.evidence: Low fog, long shadows and differentiated foliage establish layered terrain.
view-17.png.regressions: Distant troops and some armor merge into the muted haze.

view-18.png.evidence: Two brackets sit across the water-to-deck boundary, while deck, island, hull and wake remain distinct.
view-18.png.regressions: Wake has a soft edge and broad plume.

view-19.png.evidence: Thin light and dark bracket edges still mark the pilot in a soft, smoky swarm. Sea texture contrasts with orange sparks.
view-19.png.regressions: Soft overlapping wings crowd both cues and the card hides an upper crossing.

view-20.png.evidence: Deck remains visible through restrained combat particles and aircraft separate against teal water.
view-20.png.regressions: Several aircraft cross the deck or HUD; low resolution merges fine smoke and markings.

view-21.png.evidence: Tight foliage contacts, clear runway markings and deep hangar shadows separate vertical layers. Brackets frame the dark wings over the hangar.
view-21.png.regressions: Hangar and pilot still occupy nearly the same footprint.

view-22.png.evidence: Open sea separates cleanly from the airfield; plane and navigation arrow remain legible.
view-22.png.regressions: Straight beach edge and soft terrain lose surface definition.

view-23.png.evidence: The runway arrow and roof outlines survive the softer rendering; crisp brackets frame the center subject.
view-23.png.regressions: Overlap still makes the plane body less obvious than the bracket position.

view-24.png.evidence: Consistent hangar group and runway markings carry the facility read.
view-24.png.regressions: Blue aircraft merges with a similarly colored roof; simple beach and fuzzy scenery.

view-25.png.evidence: Crisp deck and cream aircraft separate from the broken sea; pale brackets find the dark bow pilot.
view-25.png.regressions: A cream nose crosses the bow silhouette.

view-26.png.evidence: Crisp deck lines and raised island clarify orientation; short highlights mark the sea.
view-26.png.regressions: Wake remains soft and the player overlaps the bow.

view-27.png.evidence: Layered silhouettes, glows and cool terrain support a strongly localized explosion.
view-27.png.regressions: The right burst and busy silhouettes conceal some units.

view-28.png.evidence: Pale aircraft still show against blue water.
view-28.png.regressions: Deck overlap, a rigid wake, center text and fuzzy circular effects reduce separation.

view-29.png.evidence: Fine ocean detail separates from broad wake and the crisp hull edge. Left bracket over water and right bracket over deck identify the pilot cleanly.
view-29.png.regressions: The wake is still soft and broad near the stern.

view-30.png.evidence: Sharp runway and field boundaries make the scene easy to parse at a glance.
view-30.png.regressions: Objective overlaps aircraft; generic water flecks do little to connect water to shore.

view-31.png.evidence: Fine water pattern separates from the broader stern wake. The brackets are crisp through softer rendering.
view-31.png.regressions: Soft deck and wing edges limit detail.

view-32.png.evidence: Fine broken water provides a richer backdrop to cream aircraft and a clear carrier outline. Pale brackets frame the dark player without covering wing paint.
view-32.png.regressions: A cream nose and gold pipper still share its bow silhouette.

view-33.png.evidence: A darker bracket edge keeps the pilot locator legible at the bright coast. The low offshore contrast is different from shallows.
view-33.png.regressions: Soft trees lose scale and shoreline foam remains broken.

view-34.png.evidence: Sharp pale aircraft and good carrier markings help separate the formation.
view-34.png.regressions: Water glints resemble tracer flecks; the bow pileup remains ambiguous.

view-35.png.evidence: Large field and sea areas are distinct in layout and color.
view-35.png.regressions: The objective covers the plane and the field grid overwhelms the softer plane silhouette.

view-36.png.evidence: Tighter contacts leave more grass visible between the soft trees, and fine offshore waves contrast with the calmer shallows. Brackets remain crisp and centered on the plane.
view-36.png.regressions: Foliage loses scale in the soft view, and the beach foam is broken.

view-37.png.evidence: Pale aircraft stand out over blue water.
view-37.png.regressions: Blocky wake and center overlays disrupt depth; circular particles conceal deck detail.

view-38.png.evidence: Crisp aircraft and facility lines; teal water cleanly separates from grass.
view-38.png.regressions: Beach line is too uniform and detached white flecks give little surf depth.

view-39.png.evidence: Small broken water marks give the fleet scene greater surface scale without merging with the wakes. Cyan brackets frame the player among cream wings, sparks and smoke.
view-39.png.regressions: Closely packed wings, sparks and the gold pipper still make the deck busy.

view-40.png.evidence: Cream wings and the carrier remain distinct against largely quiet water.
view-40.png.regressions: Bow overlaps several aircraft and soft effects convey little impact.

view-41.png.evidence: Fine ocean texture sits behind the softened deck. Cyan brackets stay crisp, and the off-deck wings remain easy to separate from the player area.
view-41.png.regressions: Cream aircraft and the gold pipper still crowd the bow pilot.

view-42.png.evidence: Single carrier and distinct deck markings read quickly against restrained teal water.
view-42.png.regressions: Player nose is close to the bow; the wake is soft and simple.

view-43.png.evidence: Small compact tree contacts along the road and yard make the airfield lighting more coherent. The crisp brackets identify the soft aircraft over the hangar.
view-43.png.regressions: Grass and hangar remain soft and the aircraft crosses the roof line.

view-44.png.evidence: Crisp side brackets mark the bow aircraft despite softer edges. Fine ocean pattern separates from the smoother directional wake.
view-44.png.regressions: Soft deck and wing edges still limit detail.

view-45.png.evidence: Compact shadows keep coastal trees legible as individual crowns. Fine water flows into a brighter shallow-water band. The brackets keep their dark edge close to the beach.
view-45.png.regressions: The beach remains angular, and a few crown shapes repeat.
